Header.Name: Source
Header.Description: Minimum and mandatory metadata elements common to all resources.

Element.name: nameOrTitle
Element.clariah:label: Source's key title
Element.clariah:explanation: Enter the source's key title, also used as folder title, the same entered in the Zotero "Extra" field. See documentation at: https://edu.nl/avfnw

Element.name: mainType
Element.clariah:label: Source's main type
Element.clariah:explanation: Select the source's main type. See documentation at: https://edu.nl/avfnw

Element.name: additionalSourceType
Element.clariah:label: Source's additional type
Element.clariah:explanation: Select the source's additional type. See documentation at: https://edu.nl/avfnw

Element.name: internalType
Element.clariah:label: Source's reliability type
Element.clariah:explanation: Select the source's internal type. See documentation at: https://edu.nl/avfnw

Element.name: accessURL
Element.clariah:label: Source's cloud link
Element.clariah:explanation: Find the link to the folder in Research Drive and paste it here. See documentation at: https://edu.nl/avfnw

Element.name: zoteroGroupItemLink
Element.clariah:label: Zotero group item link
Element.clariah:explanation: Find the link to the source's reference in Zotero and paste it here. See documentation at: https://edu.nl/avfnw

Component.name: RecordWorkflowStatus
Component.clariah:label: Source work status
Component.clariah:explanation: Select the current work status for this source. See documentation at: https://edu.nl/avfnw

Element.name: recordStatus
Element.clariah:label: Source status
Element.clariah:explanation: Select the most specific type. See documentation at: https://edu.nl/avfnw

Component.name: Note
Component.clariah:explanation: Use notes for any additional information or action points related to the source. See documentation at: https://edu.nl/avfnw

Element.name: noteType
Element.clariah:label: Note type
Element.clariah:explanation: Select the most specific type. See documentation at: https://edu.nl/avfnw
